Tunnel Trouble#000.src: May the woman who died here in tonight's raid rest in peace. Though we did not know her name, her memory will live on through her son.

Tunnel Trouble#001.src: Now, here's where you come in- I need you to clear out that cave route so we can use it once more! Good luck, soldier!
Tunnel Trouble#001.dst: Тут-то мне и нужна твоя помощь: расчисти пещеру, чтобы ею снова пользоваться! Удачи, солдат!

Tunnel Trouble#002.src: I can see the other side! Just a little bit more...

Tunnel Trouble#003.src: [!] Right-Click the gates of the cow pens to open them and free the cows!

Tunnel Trouble#004.src: Go free those cows from the farmers before they're taken to the slaughterhouse! Oh man, the slaughterhouse...

Tunnel Trouble#005.src: Looks like you freed the cows successfully! You should return to Drale, before-

Tunnel Trouble#006.src: An intruder! What are you doing with my cows!? Guard golem! Attack!
Tunnel Trouble#006.dst: Чужак! Что ты делаешь с моими коровами?! Голем-страж, в атаку!

Tunnel Trouble#007.src: You've defeated Bylvis' Guard Golem! You're in the clear now, and the cows are saved! You should return to Drale.

Tunnel Trouble#008.src: Hello again, friend! I'm here with the help! Cows, to me!

Tunnel Trouble#009.src: You can... go on ahead. Tell whoever's on the other end that we succeeded. And while you do that, I'll be searching for a better career.

Tunnel Trouble#011.src: Talk to Captain Fenor in front of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Tunnel Trouble#011.dst: Поговори с Капитаном Fenor перед {p} на [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Tunnel Trouble#012.src: Ah! You must be a new recruit! Well, I've got a mission for you.
Tunnel Trouble#012.dst: А! Ты, должно быть, новобранец! Что ж, есть для тебя задание.
Tunnel Trouble#012.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#013.src: There's an old cave behind me. It was used in the Corruption Wars...
Tunnel Trouble#013.dst: За мной старая пещера. Её использовали в Войнах Скверны...
Tunnel Trouble#013.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#014.src: We used it for quick and easy travel between {p} and {p}. It’s been abandoned for years.
Tunnel Trouble#014.dst: По ней мы быстро ходили между {p} и {p}. Она заброшена много лет.
Tunnel Trouble#014.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#015.src: This cave could prove to be very useful for future recruits who need to travel between {p} and {p}.
Tunnel Trouble#015.dst: Она очень пригодится новобранцам, которым надо ходить между {p} и {p}.
Tunnel Trouble#015.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#017.src: Enter the cave behind Captain Fenor at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Tunnel Trouble#017.dst: Войди в пещеру за Капитаном Fenor на [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Tunnel Trouble#018.src: ...Oh! Shoot, is it time to get to work already?
Tunnel Trouble#018.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#020.src: Uh... well, to start, we'll need to clear that debris. Just... give it a shove, or something. That'll probably do it.
Tunnel Trouble#020.dst: Э... ну, для начала надо убрать завал. Просто... толкни его, что ли. Наверное, сработает.
Tunnel Trouble#020.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#021.src: Help Miner Linton remove the debris blocking the path.

Tunnel Trouble#022.src: Pretty easy, huh? Hey, maybe you can just go on ahead, and do the rest yourself?
Tunnel Trouble#022.dst: Легко, да? Слушай, может, дальше справишься без меня?
Tunnel Trouble#022.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#023.src: ...Yeah, no, I should probably do my job. Let me grab my pickaxe, and we can keep going forward.
Tunnel Trouble#023.dst: ...Не, наверное, стоит делать свою работу. Возьму кирку, и двинемся дальше.
Tunnel Trouble#023.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#024.src: Clear the cave of possible roadblocks.

Tunnel Trouble#025.src: Oh, come on... Hey, soldier, do your job! Get rid of those monsters, would you?
Tunnel Trouble#025.dst: Ну вот... Эй, солдат, работай! Убери этих монстров, а?
Tunnel Trouble#025.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#027.src: A cave-in? Really? More work for me... I'll make us a way through, just keep fighting those corrupteds!
Tunnel Trouble#027.dst: Обвал? Серьёзно? Опять мне работы... Я прокопаю проход, а ты бей осквернённых!
Tunnel Trouble#027.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#028.src: Halfway there... Ugh, I knew I should have brought explosives...
Tunnel Trouble#028.dst: Полпути... Эх, знал ведь, что надо взять взрывчатку...
Tunnel Trouble#028.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#029.src: I can see the other side! Just a little more...
Tunnel Trouble#029.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#030.src: There we go, I've made us a hole! Get over here, quickly!
Tunnel Trouble#030.dst: Готово, есть дыра! Давай сюда, быстро!
Tunnel Trouble#030.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#031.src: ...Oh, come on. You've got to be kidding me. Another cave-in? Really?
Tunnel Trouble#031.dst: ...Да ну. Шутишь, что ли? Ещё один обвал? Серьёзно?
Tunnel Trouble#031.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#032.src: And of course it's bigger than the last one. What's my pickaxe going to do against this thing?!
Tunnel Trouble#032.dst: И конечно, больше прошлого. Что моя кирка сделает с этой громадой?!
Tunnel Trouble#032.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#033.src: Really should have thought to bring explosives. Well, soldier, we tried our best! Nobody'll blame us if we give up now.
Tunnel Trouble#033.dst: Надо было взять взрывчатку. Что ж, солдат, мы старались! Никто не упрекнёт нас, если сдадимся.
Tunnel Trouble#033.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#034.src: ...What? Don't look at me like that. Fine, we can- huh? Do you hear that? Over there, to the right.
Tunnel Trouble#034.dst: ...Что? Не смотри так. Ладно, можем- а? Слышишь? Вон там, справа.
Tunnel Trouble#034.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#035.src: Oh, uh... Hi... Well, this is a little awkward... I'll just... Go.
Tunnel Trouble#035.dst: О, э... Привет... Как-то неловко... Я, пожалуй... пойду.

Tunnel Trouble#036.src: ...You know what? I'm not going to ask. As far as I'm concerned, that didn't happen.
Tunnel Trouble#036.dst: ...Знаешь что? Не буду спрашивать. Для меня этого не было.
Tunnel Trouble#036.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#037.src: Right, of course you want to check it out. Fine! Go ahead. I'll just... sit here and twiddle my thumbs 'till you're back.
Tunnel Trouble#037.dst: Ну конечно, тебе интересно. Ладно! Иди. А я посижу тут, побездельничаю, пока не вернёшься.
Tunnel Trouble#037.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#038.src: Investigate the small hole to the right of the large pile of debris.
Tunnel Trouble#038.dst: Осмотри маленькую дыру справа от большого завала.

Tunnel Trouble#039.src: Oh... Didn't expect you to follow me... Well, um... Hi! This will sound mad but...
Tunnel Trouble#039.dst: О... Не думал, что ты пойдёшь за мной... Ну, эм... Привет! Звучит безумно, но...
Tunnel Trouble#039.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#040.src: I'm Drale, and I'm on a mission to free these cows from the enslavement of {p}.
Tunnel Trouble#040.dst: Я Drale, и моя миссия - освободить этих коров из рабства {p}.
Tunnel Trouble#040.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#041.src: Those farmers stole those cows. They are sacred animals. Now they're about to turn them into steak! If you were to help me, maybe I could help you...
Tunnel Trouble#041.dst: Фермеры украли этих коров. Это священные животные. А теперь из них сделают стейки! Поможешь мне - может, и я тебе помогу...
Tunnel Trouble#041.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#042.src: Go free those innocent cows from enslavement! Qu-quickly! Before that farmer gets back...
Tunnel Trouble#042.dst: Освободи этих невинных коров из рабства! Б-быстрее! Пока фермер не вернулся...
Tunnel Trouble#042.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#043.src: Where are you going? Come here and talk to me first.
Tunnel Trouble#043.dst: Куда ты? Сначала подойди и поговори со мной.
Tunnel Trouble#043.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#044.src: Free the cows without being seen by the farmer.
Tunnel Trouble#044.dst: Освободи коров, не попавшись на глаза фермеру.

Tunnel Trouble#045.src: Go free the cows from the farmers before they're taken to the slaughterhouse! Oh man, the slaughterhouse...
Tunnel Trouble#045.dst: Освободи коров, пока фермеры не отправили их на бойню! О-ох, бойня...
Tunnel Trouble#045.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#046.src: Ah, good to see my cows are all in tip-top shape! Welp, time to- gah!
Tunnel Trouble#046.dst: Ах, мои коровы в отличной форме! Ну, пора- ах!
Tunnel Trouble#046.speaker: Bylvis

Tunnel Trouble#049.src: Golem! No! That cost me thousands of emeralds!
Tunnel Trouble#049.dst: Голем! Нет! Он стоил мне тысячи изумрудов!
Tunnel Trouble#049.speaker: Bylvis

Tunnel Trouble#050.src: Return to Drale about your success.
Tunnel Trouble#050.dst: Вернись к Drale и расскажи об успехе.

Tunnel Trouble#051.src: Thank you so much, but we're not done yet. We need to get these cows out the province.
Tunnel Trouble#051.dst: Огромное спасибо, но это не всё. Надо вывезти коров из провинции.
Tunnel Trouble#051.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#052.src: There's a small opening behind me. Go through it and help me get these cows on a raft to Gavel!
Tunnel Trouble#052.dst: За мной есть узкий проход. Пройди и помоги погрузить коров на плот до Gavel!
Tunnel Trouble#052.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#053.src: Help Drale push the raft with the cows out to sea.
Tunnel Trouble#053.dst: Помоги Drale вытолкнуть плот с коровами в море.

Tunnel Trouble#054.src: There's the raft! Help me push it for the cows!
Tunnel Trouble#054.dst: Вот и плот! Помоги столкнуть его ради коров!
Tunnel Trouble#054.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#055.src: And, that should do it! Be free, my friends! A new life awaits!
Tunnel Trouble#055.dst: Вот, готово! Будьте свободны, друзья! Вас ждёт новая жизнь!
Tunnel Trouble#055.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#056.src: Again, thank you so much for what you have done this day. These cows deserve a better life than being farm animals.
Tunnel Trouble#056.dst: Ещё раз огромное спасибо за сегодняшнее. Эти коровы достойны лучшей жизни, чем на ферме.
Tunnel Trouble#056.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#057.src: ...Oh! Right! You were busy with something before you came to help me, weren't you? Hm... I think I might be able to help you with that as well! Let's go back to the tunnel!
Tunnel Trouble#057.dst: ...О! Точно! У тебя ведь было своё дело, до того как помочь мне? Хм... Думаю, с ним я тоже смогу помочь! Идём обратно в туннель!
Tunnel Trouble#057.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#058.src: Return to Miner Linton back in the abandoned cave.
Tunnel Trouble#058.dst: Вернись к Шахтёру Linton в заброшенную пещеру.

Tunnel Trouble#059.src: Oh, good, you're back. It's been, like, an hour! What were you even doing for that long!
Tunnel Trouble#059.dst: О, ты тут. Прошёл, считай, час! Что можно было так долго делать?!
Tunnel Trouble#059.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#060.src: ...You helped some crazy cow-obsessed lunatic steal some cows? I don't think you're allowed to do that. There's a law against that, or something.
Tunnel Trouble#060.dst: ...Помогать чокнутому коровьему фанатику красть коров? Вроде так нельзя. Есть же закон против этого, или типа того.
Tunnel Trouble#060.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#061.src: Eh. Not that I really care, either way. I've certainly done worse.
Tunnel Trouble#061.dst: Эх. Мне-то, в общем, всё равно. Я делал вещи и похуже.
Tunnel Trouble#061.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#062.src: Well then! Ready to call it quits? We're definitely not going to make any progress, so we might as we-
Tunnel Trouble#062.dst: Ну что! Закругляемся? Прогресса нам точно не видать, так что можно и-
Tunnel Trouble#062.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#063.src: Hello again, friend! I'm here with help! Cows, to me!
Tunnel Trouble#063.dst: Снова привет, друг! Я с подмогой! Коровы, ко мне!
Tunnel Trouble#063.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#065.src: Since you helped me with my problem, I thought I should repay that favor by helping you!
Tunnel Trouble#065.dst: За помощь с моей бедой я решил отплатить тебе тем же!
Tunnel Trouble#065.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#066.src: Welp, see ya! Oh, and nice to meet you, miner! Now, let's get going my cows!
Tunnel Trouble#066.dst: Ну, пока! И рад знакомству, шахтёр! А теперь в путь, мои коровы!
Tunnel Trouble#066.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#067.src: ...I- huh. You saw that too, right? I didn't just imagine that?
Tunnel Trouble#067.dst: ...Я- хм. Это ведь правда было? Мне не почудилось?
Tunnel Trouble#067.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#068.src: You know what? I think I quit. I think this has finally pushed me to my limit! I didn't know that I had one, but apparently I do!
Tunnel Trouble#068.dst: Знаешь что? Я, пожалуй, увольняюсь. Это мой предел! Не знал, что он у меня есть, но, видимо, есть!
Tunnel Trouble#068.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#069.src: You can... go on ahead. Tell whoever's on the other end that we succeeded. And while we do that, I'll be searching for a better career.
Tunnel Trouble#069.dst: Можешь... идти дальше. Скажи тем, кто на той стороне, что мы справились. А я пока поищу работу получше.
Tunnel Trouble#069.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#071.src: Speak to Sergeant Klafson next to the {p} entrance of the cave.
Tunnel Trouble#071.dst: Поговори с Сержантом Klafson у выхода из пещеры со стороны {p}.

Tunnel Trouble#072.src: Recruit, Captain Fenor told me to meet you here, said if you came out on this side of that tunnel then you completed your mission!
Tunnel Trouble#072.dst: Новобранец, Капитан Fenor велел ждать тебя здесь: если выйдешь с этой стороны туннеля, задание выполнено!
Tunnel Trouble#072.speaker: Sergeant Klafson

Tunnel Trouble#073.src: You did a great deed today, soldier! We can now use this cave to travel easily between {p} and {p}! Great job!
Tunnel Trouble#073.dst: Славное дело сегодня, солдат! Теперь по пещере легко ходить между {p} и {p}! Отлично!
Tunnel Trouble#073.speaker: Sergeant Klafson
